categories.main_business_segments: Scantech (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the 3D visual digitalization industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of 3D visual digitalization products and systems. Its main product lines include handheld 3D scanners, tracking 3D visual digitalization products, and industrial-grade automated 3D visual inspection systems. The company serves both industrial-grade applications such as aerospace, automotive manufacturing, engineering machinery, and transportation, as well as professional-grade applications including education, 3D printing, cultural heritage, medical health, public security, and virtual worlds.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated 'optics, mechanics, electronics, computing, and software' technologies to develop high-precision, portable, and intelligent 3D visual digitalization systems. Key technologies include multi-band scanning, multi-band calibration, embedded photogrammetry composite scanning, fast high-precision edge computing, and wireless scanning technology. Its products utilize non-contact optical 3D scanning based on laser and structured light, combined with advanced algorithms for real-time 3D reconstruction, point cloud processing, and intelligent data analysis. Production involves assembly of laser modules, image acquisition modules, optical calibration, and rigorous quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are leading enterprises in aerospace, automotive manufacturing, engineering machinery, transportation, and 3C electronics sectors. Notable clients include China Aerospace Corporation, COMAC, BYD, FAW-Volkswagen, CATL, SAIC Volkswagen, Tesla, Zoomlion, XCMG, and ZTE. It also serves research institutions and universities such as the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, Zhejiang University, and Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics. The products are applied in manufacturing quality control, product design, reverse engineering, digital cultural heritage preservation, medical modeling, public security forensics, and virtual reality.
categories.geographic_coverage: Scantech operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has established subsidiaries in Germany (Scantech Digital GmbH) and the United States (Scantech Digital, Inc.) to support overseas sales and services. The company has expanded its local service centers in Southeast Asia and South America, building localized sales, technical support, and after-sales teams to better serve global markets. Overseas revenue accounted for approximately 42.9% of total revenue in 2024, reflecting significant international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the 3D visual digitalization supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of 3D scanning hardware and software solutions. It procures key components such as industrial cameras, optical lenses, and computing modules, some of which are customized or self-developed to meet high precision requirements. The company controls core manufacturing processes including laser module assembly, optical calibration, and software integration, while outsourcing non-core components and general assembly tasks to external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Scantech emphasizes independent innovation and technology leadership, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on core technologies such as multi-band laser scanning, edge computing, and intelligent wireless scanning. The company aims to enhance product portability, scanning speed, and accuracy while expanding applications into emerging fields like AI, digital twins, virtual reality, augmented reality, and robotics. Strategic collaborations, such as with Hangzhou Lingban Technology for AR integration, and ODM partnerships with global leaders like Artec3D and FARO, support its global technology and market expansion. The company also prioritizes building a comprehensive technology ecosystem integrating hardware, algorithms, and software platforms.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sales of 3D visual digitalization products including handheld scanners, tracking scanners, and automated inspection systems. It also earns income from related software platforms and after-sales services. Sales are conducted mainly through a buyout distribution model complemented by direct sales to key customers. Additionally, the company receives government subsidies and investment income, which contribute to overall profitability but are not the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Scantech is a leading domestic player in China's industrial-grade 3D visual digitalization market, holding the top market share in handheld laser 3D scanners. It competes with global incumbents such as Hexagon, Carl Zeiss, and Artec3D. The company differentiates itself through rapid technology iteration, proprietary core technologies, and strong integration of hardware and software. Its products have been recognized with provincial and national awards, and it is designated as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. Its strategic ODM partnerships further strengthen its competitive positioning internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Scantech achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 332.6 million, representing a 22.41% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 120.5 million, up 5.49%, with net profit excluding non-recurring items growing 11.51%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 745.5 million, a 28.92% increase year-over-year, and net assets attributable to shareholders grew 27.37% to RMB 624.7 million. R&D investment accounted for 17.76% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company’s international revenue grew significantly, with overseas sales increasing by 55.73%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Scantech offers high-precision, portable, and intelligent 3D visual digitalization solutions that enable non-contact, rapid, and accurate 3D data acquisition and modeling. Its products integrate advanced optical, mechanical, electronic, and computational technologies to deliver superior scanning accuracy (up to 0.02mm), high stability, and ease of use in complex industrial environments. The company’s proprietary multi-band laser scanning, edge computing, and wireless scanning technologies provide competitive advantages in speed, flexibility, and application breadth. Its solutions support full lifecycle digitalization in manufacturing, cultural heritage preservation, medical applications, and emerging virtual and augmented reality fields, empowering customers with comprehensive digital transformation capabilities.
